prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Stage Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate view to use a stage layout, putting full visual emphasis on finalizing pet details.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Finalize Your Desktop Pet Adoption", "body": "Confirm your companion's details to safely complete adoption."}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Post-Setup Launch Preparation Screen: Add a dedicated final launch preparation screen before launching the pet onto the desktop screen.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_launch_prep", "home_intro"], "new_launch_prep": {"headline": "Ready to Summon Companion", "body": "Your desktop pet is generated and ready to appear on your screen.", "button_label": "Launch Pet", "layout": "centered"}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In Before Certificate: Shift sign-in screen to take place after photo upload and right before adoption certificate confirmation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Verification Flow Step: Insert a dedicated photo confirmation screen into the adoption sequence to verify rendering quality.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_review", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_photo_review": {"headline": "Review Pet Render Quality", "body": "Ensure your custom pet image looks correct before adoption.", "button_label": "Looks Great", "layout": "centered"}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Save Data Clarification: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly clarify that signing in binds pet save data permanently.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Protect Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Your companion progress and custom attributes will be permanently tied to this account."}}
5: [home, hint] Waiting Screen Desktop Status Hint: Add an explicit hint on the waiting screen clarifying background setup and file placement.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Assets are loading into system memory. Please leave this window open until launch."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Completion Alert Toggle: Enable desktop notification options and time estimates on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
7: [choose_path, incentive] Path Selection Starter Perk Copy: Frame path selection headline around claiming initial pet perks and starter traits.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose Your Path & Unlock Starter Perks", "body": "Select a journey path to customize your companion's initial traits and perks."}}
8: [finish, layout] Full Bleed Welcome Screen Layout: Change the home_intro screen layout to full_bleed for maximum visual call-to-action impact.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion Has Arrived", "button_label": "Bring Pet to Desktop"}}
9: [choose_path, hint] Story Step Flexibility Hint: Add a reassurance hint on the story screen informing users that companion choices can be adjusted later.
   config: {"story": {"hint": "All path and pet choices can be changed at any time in app settings."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding a new launch preparation screen within onboarding is allowed.
Reordering sign-in before adoption certificate is permitted under onboarding flexibility.
Adding a photo review screen during onboarding is permitted.
Updating copy on the sign-in screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding helpful setup hints to the waiting screen is permitted.
Enabling notification options and real time estimates on the waiting screen is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions unlocking starter perks, violating Rule 3 which forbids mentioning gifts, perks, discounts, or free extras.
Redesigning the home_intro screen layout inside onboarding is permitted.
Adding reassurance hints on the story screen is permitted.
